definitions.width_m: distance between the team's widest outfield players across the pitch
definitions.depth_m: distance between the team's deepest and most advanced outfield players
definitions.area_m2: area of the shape around all outfield players (smaller = more compact)
definitions.back_line_m: average distance of the 4 deepest outfield players from their own goal line
definitions.players_behind_ball: outfield players between the ball and their own goal (average over the window); 0 means the ball is closer to their goal than all of them, i.e. the defence has been bypassed
definitions.ball_zone: where the ball mostly was in the window, seen from the focus team attacking towards the opponent's goal
definitions.ball_carriers: player nearest the ball (within 1.5 m, ball below 1 m) for at least 0.12 s, in time order
